none: PAS FindID 973968: Roman copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, Urbs Roma commemorative, dating from AD 330 to 335 (Reece Period 17). Reverse type Wolf and Twins [VRBS ROMA]. Probably minted in Trier. Diameter 16mm, and the weight 1.24g. Obverse inscription VRBS ROMA. No reverse inscription
